subject: Legend labels overplot when using italic or bold

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Legend labels overplot when using italic or bold
parts:
Hi group, when I change the font face and use multiple lines labels in the legend, they overplot making them unreadeable. Am I the only one with this issue? I remember this worked in the past.

Cheers

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point(aes(colour = factor(cyl)))

#Plain font face
p + scale_colour_hue(breaks = levels(factor(mtcars$cyl)),
    labels = c("4\nFour", "6\nSix", "8\nEight"))

#Italic   
p + scale_colour_hue(breaks = levels(factor(mtcars$cyl)),
    labels = c(expression(italic("4\nFour")), expression(italic("6\nSix")),
     expression(italic("8\nEight"))))

#Bold
p + scale_colour_hue(breaks = levels(factor(mtcars$cyl)),
    labels = c(expression(bold("4\nFour")), expression(bold("6\nSix")),
     expression(bold("8\nEight"))))

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Legend labels overplot when using italic or bold
parts:
Hi,

I think expression() and " " are somewhat incompatible in R,

l = expression(bold("8 Eight"))
grid.text(l)
grid.rect(height=stringHeight(l),width=stringWidth(l))

so you have to use either a single line, or multiple lines of pure text,

l = "8 Eight"
grid.text(l)
grid.rect(height=stringHeight(l),width=stringWidth(l))

HTH,

baptiste
